description_en: Queries all AccessKey pairs that belong to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用ListAccessKeys接口列出指定用户的访问密钥
name: ListAccessKeys

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM user. If a RAM user calls this operation and does not specify this parameter, the AccessKey pairs of the RAM user are returned
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户，RAM用户访问时不提供此参数则表示列出自己的访问密钥
parameters.name: user_name
